hero.heading: Garage Management Software Built for
hero.description: 4x code Garage Management System is all-in-one garage management software designed for independent garages, automotive repair workshops, mechanics, and vehicle service businesses. It brings customer records, vehicle histories, service bookings, job tracking, quotations, digital inspections, and customer communication together in one connected platform. Instead of juggling paperwork, spreadsheets, and phone notes, your team can organise daily workshop activity in one place, keep every job moving, and give customers a more professional, transparent service experience.

paragraphs: Your garage handles valuable customer details, vehicle records, and financial information every day. Keeping this information organised and accessible only to the right people protects your business and builds customer trust.

Our Garage Management System uses role-based user accounts, so owners, managers, and technicians each see what they need. Managers keep full visibility over jobs, invoices, and workshop activity at all times.

faqSection.label: FAQs
faqSection.heading: Garage Software
faqSection.description: Find answers about our Garage Management System's features, pricing, setup, and everyday use in your workshop.

faqs.q: Which garages can use 4XCODE's garage management software?
faqs.a: Our software is designed for independent garages, automotive repair workshops, mobile mechanics, MOT and service centres, and vehicle repair businesses. Whether you run a single-bay workshop or a busy multi-bay garage, the system adapts to your daily workflow and team size.

faqs.q: What daily garage activities can the Garage Management System help manage?
faqs.a: The system helps you manage customer records, vehicle histories, bookings, job cards, technician assignments, digital inspections, quotations, customer approvals, invoicing, and service reminders. Reporting tools also give you a clear overview of workshop activity, payments, and performance, all from one connected auto repair garage software platform.

faqs.q: How does pricing work for your garage software plans?
faqs.a: We offer three plans: Essential for smaller garages, Advanced for busier workshops needing inspections and reporting, and Enterprise with custom pricing for larger operations. Each plan includes different features, so you can choose the option that best matches your garage's needs.

faqs.q: How can my garage start using the Garage Management System?
faqs.a: Start by booking a demo with our team. We will understand your workshop's requirements, set up your account, and help import your existing customer and vehicle information. Our team then guides your staff through the system so they feel confident using it.

faqs.q: Is support available after the software has been set up?
faqs.a: Yes. Our support team helps with technical questions, troubleshooting, and using new features as your garage grows. We also release regular software improvements, and the level of support available depends on the plan you choose for your workshop.
